metrics.label: Points scored / game
metrics.description: Team scoring, including defensive and special-teams scores; not isolated offensive scoring.

metrics.label: Overall EPA / play
metrics.description: Expected points added on offensive plays.

metrics.label: Passing EPA / play
metrics.description: Expected points added on pass plays, including sacks.

metrics.label: Rushing EPA / play
metrics.description: Expected points added on rushing plays.

metrics.label: Points allowed / game
metrics.description: Team points allowed, including scores conceded by offense and special teams; not isolated defensive scoring.

metrics.label: Overall EPA allowed / play
metrics.description: Opponent expected points added on offensive plays.

metrics.label: Overall special-teams EPA
metrics.description: Net EPA attributed to the special-teams unit; requires verified play-level attribution.

metrics.label: Kicking EPA
metrics.description: EPA attributable to field goals and extra points, not raw kicking percentage.

metrics.label: Punting EPA
metrics.description: Net punt-play EPA, including field position and return outcomes.

metrics.label: Return EPA
metrics.description: EPA attributable to punt and kickoff returns; requires verified return opportunities.
